newsitem.title: ESTONIA: DRAFT STATE BUDGET TO GO TO GOVERNMENT BY AUG 13.
newsitem.headline: DRAFT STATE BUDGET TO GO TO GOVERNMENT BY AUG 13.

text.p: The draft state budget for 1998 is to be presented to the government by August 13, the finance ministry said on Wednesday.
According to present data the 1998 draft budget is 9.7 percent or 1.2 billion kroons larger than the 1997 budget with a volume of 13.7 billion kroons, the ministry said in a statment.
However, the ministry said that changes could be made after details of revenue collection for the first eight months of 1997 are completed.
The finance ministry said that dicussions with the ministries on the draft will take two weeks and end on August 8.
The state budget must be presented to the parliament no later than September 24.
